Meanwhile, she must contend with a mysterious group called the Dark Circle as it searches for a powerful weapon held in the Academy’s vault.

items.listTitle: Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham
items.title: Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham
items.overview: Explorer Bruce Wayne accidentally unleashes an ancient evil, and returns to Gotham after being away for two decades. There, Batman battles Lovecraftian supernatural forces and encounters allies and enemies such as Green Arrow, Ra's al Ghul, Mr. Freeze, Killer Croc, Two-Face and James Gordon.

items.title: My Adventures with Superman
items.overview: Twenty-somethings Clark Kent, the bright and driven Lois Lane, and their best friend Jimmy Olsen begin to discover who they are and everything they can accomplish together as an investigative reporting team at the Daily Planet.

items.title: Justice League: Warworld
items.overview: Until now, the Justice League has been a loose association of superpowered individuals. But when they are swept away to Warworld, a place of unending brutal gladiatorial combat, Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman and the others must somehow unite to form an unbeatable resistance able to lead an entire planet to freedom.

items.title: Merry Little Batman
items.overview: This Christmas, Damian Wayne wants to be a superhero like his dad – the one and only Batman. When Damian is left home alone while Batman takes on Gotham’s worst supervillains on Christmas Eve, he stumbles upon a villainous plot to steal Christmas and leaps at the chance to save the day.

items.title: Suicide Squad Isekai
items.overview: In the crime-ridden city of Gotham, Amanda Waller, the head of A.R.G.U.S., assembles a group of notorious criminals—Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Peacemaker, Clayface and King Shark—for a mission into an otherworldly realm that's connected to this world through a gate. It's a realm of swords and magic where orcs rampage and dragons rule the skies. Can Harley Quinn and her crew conquer this perilous realm?

items.title: Kite Man: Hell Yeah!
items.overview: Lovable loser Kite Man and his new squeeze Golden Glider moonlight as criminals to support their foolish purchase of Noonan's, Gotham's seediest dive bar, where everybody knows your name, but not necessarily your secret identity!

items.title: Batman: Caped Crusader
items.overview: Welcome to Gotham City, where the corrupt outnumber the good, criminals run rampant and law-abiding citizens live in a constant state of fear. Forged in the fire of tragedy, wealthy socialite Bruce Wayne becomes something both more and less than human—the Batman. His one-man crusade for justice attracts unexpected allies within the GCPD and City Hall, but his heroic actions spawn deadly, unforeseen ramifications.

items.title: Watchmen: Chapter I
items.overview: In 1985, the murder of a government-sponsored superhero draws his outlawed colleagues out of retirement and into a mystery that threatens to upend their personal lives and the world itself.

items.title: Watchmen: Chapter II
items.overview: Suspicious of the events ensnaring their former colleagues, Nite Owl and Silk Spectre are spurred out of retirement to investigate. As they grapple with personal ethics, inner demons and a society turned against them, they race the clock to uncover a deepening plot that might trigger global nuclear war.

items.title: Creature Commandos
items.overview: Follow the exploits of the Creature Commandos, a secret team of incarcerated monsters recruited for missions deemed too dangerous for humans. When all else fails... they're your last, worst option.

items.title: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires
items.overview: In the time of the Aztec empire, tragedy strikes Yohualli Coatl when his father is murdered by Spanish conquistadors. To warn King Moctezuma and his high priest, Yoka, of imminent danger, Yohualli escapes to Tenochtitlán. There, he trains in the temple of the bat god Tzinacan with his mentor, developing equipment and weaponry to confront the Spanish invasion and avenge his father’s death. Along the way, he encounters key figures like the fierce Jaguar Woman and the conquistador Hernán Cortés.

items.title: MAD
items.overview: Mad is an American animated sketch comedy series created by Kevin Shinick and produced by Warner Bros. Animation. Based upon the magazine of the same name, each episode is a collection of short animated parodies of television shows, movies, games, celebrities, and other media using various types of animation instead of the usual animation style that Warner Bros. Animation is known for. The series premiered on the evening of September 6, 2010 on Cartoon Network. It has been described as a "kid-friendly version of Robot Chicken".

items.title: The Riddler: Riddle Me This
items.overview: The Riddler matches wits with Batman, but the encounters never go well.

items.title: Sword of the Atom
items.overview: On an expedition to the Amazon rain forest, Ray Palmer aka The Atom crashes en route, is trapped at being shrunk at 6 inches and must survive the natives he finds.

items.title: Tales of Metropolis
items.overview: Tales of Metropolis is a series of animated shorts as part of the DC Nation block on Cartoon Network. The series stars a different character every episode and follows the every day adventures of Superman's fellow Metropolis citizens such as Bizarro and Lois Lane.

items.title: Vibe
items.overview: Vibe competes in a break-dancing competition with his sidekick Daniel. They must defeat the robot Extreme-O, created by Professor Ivo, who is disguised as the judge of the competition.

items.title: World's Funnest
items.overview: A stop-motion animated series that follows a cast of kooky reimaginings of our favorite DC characters, sound-biting on a specific topic each episode. It is the only unscripted series in the DC Nation lineup, with Aardman animating over interviews of children with DC characters in their place, in the same style as their “Creature Comforts” series.

items.title: スーパーマン @ Tokyo
items.overview: Superman of Tokyo (stylized as スーパーマン @ Tokyo) is a 2012 series of animated shorts that appeared as part of the DC Nation programming block on Cartoon Network. The series drastically re-imagines the mythos of Superman as the title passes on from one hero to a diaper-wearing baby.

items.title: Shazam!
items.overview: Billy Batson is gifted with the magical ability to transform into the hero Shazam by saying his name. Billy, being only a kid, uses these special powers in ridiculous ways.

items.title: Super Best Friends Forever
items.overview: Supergirl, Batgirl and Wonder Girl are the Super Best Friends Forever.

items.title: Metal Men
items.overview: The misadventures of Dr. Magnus's team of stumblebum robot superheroes.

items.title: New Teen Titans
items.overview: A series of shorts based on 2003's Teen Titans following the antics of crime-fighting teenagers, showcasing their bite-sized adventures.

items.title: Plastic Man
items.overview: The misadventures of the original stretchable superhero.

items.title: Doom Patrol
items.overview: Doom Patrol was a series of animated shorts about the world's strangest heroes. Written by Tom Peyer and directed by Thomas Perkins, the shorts took much inspiration from Arnold Drake's original run on Doom Patrol.

items.title: Green Arrow
items.overview: Follow the Emerald Archer and his super artificial intelligence bow as he takes on crime alongside Black Canary.

items.title: Deadman
items.overview: Deadman, an innocent, lonely little ghost, tries his best to do the right thing using his powers.

items.title: DC Metal Force
items.overview: A mysterious entity has brought the powers of good and evil together to participate in the ultimate super-powered showdown!

items.title: Farm League
items.overview: The adventures of the Justice League on a comedic animal version that includes Bat-Mongoose, Wonder Wombat, and Super-Manatee

items.title: Animal Man
items.overview: Granted the power to borrow the abilities of animals, Buddy Baker aka Animal Man is dedicated to saving them. And humans. Maybe.

items.title: Amethyst: Princess of Gemworld
items.overview: An ordinary girl is pulled into the fantasy realm of Gemworld to save it from a monstrous villain.
